# agent/transcript-committed

Agent transcript or state in git.

Agent transcripts, prompt history, and local agent state tracked by git: `.claude/projects/`, `.claude/todos/`, `.specstory/history/`, `.aider.chat.history.md`, Codex and Gemini CLI session folders, and agent login files.

- Default level: `warn`.
- Looks at: the project as a whole, across files.
- References: [CWE-200](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/200.html), [CWE-532](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/532.html), OWASP ASI06.

## Why it matters

Transcripts record every file the agent read and every command output, which often includes secrets and private context, and git keeps them in history after they are deleted.

## Flagged

`.aider.chat.history.md` (warn):

```md
# aider chat started at 2026-09-01 10:00:00
```

`.claude/projects/-home-dev-app/0001.jsonl` (warn):

```text
{"type":"user","message":"fixture transcript"}
```

`.specstory/history/2026-09-01_10-00-review.md` (warn):

```md
# Review session
```

## Not flagged

- `Review the staged diff.` in `.claude/commands/review.md`: commands are meant to be shared
- `{"type":"user","message":"second session"}` in `.claude/projects/-home-dev-app/0002.jsonl`: reported once for the folder, on its first file
- `{ "permissions": { "allow": ["Bash(npm test)"] } }` in `.claude/settings.json`: shared settings are meant to be committed
- `[]` in `.claude/todos/local-todos.json`: not tracked by git, so it is not reported

## How to fix

Remove the files from git (git rm -r --cached <path>), add the folder to .gitignore, and check them for secrets that need rotating.

## If the finding is wrong

Add a comment on the line above, in the comment syntax of the file, that says who decided and why:

```
ubon-ignore agent/transcript-committed: <who decided>: <evidence>
```

Or turn the rule off for the project in `ubon.json`: `"rules": { "agent/transcript-committed": "off" }`. See [configuration](../../config.md).
